claim: As of mid-2026, on two independent long-horizon agent benchmarks—SWE-Marathon (software) and Chi-Bench (healthcare)—frontier agents complete under 30% of end-to-end tasks under each benchmark’s primary pass criteria.

evidence.quote: Current frontier coding agents solve fewer than 30% of tasks.

Across 30 agent harness/model configurations, the best agent resolves only 28.0% of tasks, no agent clears 20% on strict pass^3, and executing all tasks in a single session slumps the performance to 3.8%.

prediction.claim: By 2026-12-31, independent reproductions of the reported best-agent configurations on the public SWE-Marathon and Chi-Bench releases will measure under 30% end-to-end task success under each benchmark’s primary pass metric.
prediction.checkable: Reproduction reports or leaderboards for SWE-Marathon and Chi-Bench showing the reproduced best agents’ end-to-end success rates; if either is ≥30%, the prediction is false.

refutation_condition: A credible evaluation or independent replication in 2026 showing ≥30% end-to-end success on either SWE-Marathon or Chi-Bench for the best-reported agents under the benchmarks’ primary pass criteria.
